_comment: Drives the link-in-bio page at /links (served as https://shauna.dev/).
Adding a link = adding one entry. Nothing else needs to change.
bars[].variant  plain | dark | teal | tint | quiet   (see links.astro rest-state block)
bars[].span     grid columns out of 6. Everything is 6 today; 3 gives a half-width bar.
bars[].href     omit or null + "placeholder": true to render a non-linking TBD bar.
The Writing section is NOT listed here. It is generated from the blog content
collection so the latest post and the post count stay correct on their own.
latestPostSlug pins which post is 'latest' because two posts share a
publishedDate (2026-07-27) and a plain date sort cannot break that tie.
Remove the pin and it falls back to newest-by-date.

socials._note: WhatsApp INVITE link (wa.me/qr/...), deliberately not wa.me/<number>. A number-form link would publish Shauna's personal mobile in the page source for scrapers; this opaque code does not. Tradeoff: it carries no prefilled message, and it BREAKS SILENTLY if the QR is ever reset in WhatsApp. If that happens, re-copy the link from the app. Verified resolving 2026-08-12.

_comment: Projects in build. Rendered as NON-LINKING bars on purpose: as of 2026-08-12
none of these three serve over HTTPS. countdownproject.org has no A record at
all (registered 2026-08-13), and the other two answer with
'X-Served-By: Namecheap URL Forward', i.e. a parking redirect.
To take one live: delete the Namecheap URL Redirect Record FIRST (see
HANDOFF.md, it is what broke shauna.dev), point DNS at the host, then set
href here and delete the "building": true flag. That is the whole change.
